mapper.sql: id , return_notice_order_no, return_type, return_why, sku_count, take_effect_time, return_deadline, remark, org_code, biz_org_code, creator, create_time, updater, update_time, is_delete,status, is_effective_immediately
mapper.select:
select
from ord_dis_return_notice where is_delete=0 and biz_org_code=#{bizOrgCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and return_notice_order_no =#{returnNoticeOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select rno.id returnNoticeOrderId,rno.return_notice_order_no returnNoticeOrderNo, rno.return_type returnType,rno.create_time, rno.take_effect_time takeEffectTime, rno.remark, (select odrns.return_deadline from ord_dis_return_notice_store odrns where odrns.return_notice_order_id = rno.id limit 1) as return_deadline
, exists (select odr.return_notice_order_id from ord_dis_return odr where odr.store_code = #{storeCode} and odr.return_notice_order_id = rno.id and odr.is_delete = 0) as isReturn
from ord_dis_return_notice rno where rno.id = #{returnNoticeOrderId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
and exists(select odrns.return_notice_order_id from ord_dis_return_notice_store odrns where odrns.return_notice_order_id = rno.id and odrns.store_code = #{storeCode})

select count(rno.id) from ord_dis_return_notice rno where rno.status = 'processed' and rno.return_deadline > now() and rno.biz_org_code = #{bizOrgCode} and exists (select rns.store_code from ord_dis_return_notice_store rns where rno.id = rns.return_notice_order_id and rns.store_code = #{storeCode}) and not exists(select odr.store_code from ord_dis_return odr where odr.store_code = #{storeCode} and odr.return_notice_order_id = rno.id and odr.is_delete = 0)
